notes.title: Translations at the release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35742349/e2552d250eb2b1e4d013d2752d14ea9be4bc9fa6.png[/img]

I hope that the game will launch with these languages available:

[list]
[*] English
[*] Russian
[*] Chinese
[*] Japanese
[*] French
[/list]

Right now only English and Russian are ready, and since I sent the build for checking, I had to uncheck all unready localisations. But I hope that all of above will be available right from the start.
